title: Lentil and Curry Stew
description: A hearty, comforting stew made with lentils and a rich curry sauce. Serve over steamed rice or with naan bread.
instructions: Heat oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the garlic and sauté for 1 minute.
Add the lentils, curry, and broth. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer, covered, for 20-25 minutes, or until the lentils are tender.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh cilantro, if desired.
